items.title: 5.13.2 Rozmarra zindagi mein liquid crystals ke istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13.2, printed pages 112-113.

blocks.text: Liquid crystals ka bunyadi istemal electro-optic aalaat mein hai, barqi taur par qaboo kiye jane wale aalaat jo roshni ko matloob tarah badalte hain. Liquid crystals ke rozmarra zindagi mein bohat se istemal hain.

items: Tashkhees (diagnostics): khas liquid crystal aalaat insani jism mein tumours aur infections ki tashkhees karte hain, kyunke tumours jaise tabee masail ka darja hararat aksar gird ke tissue se mukhtalif hota hai. Jab cholesteric liquid crystals chhati par lagaye jayein to tumour baqi hisson se garam hone ki wajah se mil jata hai; yeh tareeqa chhati ke cancer ki ibtidai marhale mein tashkhees karta hai.

Makhsoos zyada darja hararat maloom karna: liquid crystal temperature sensors circuit board par kharab jor un ke zyada darja hararat se dhoond lete hain, aur thermometers mein temperature sensors ke taur par istemal hote hain.
Liquid crystal displays (LCDs): sab se aam istemal, oscillographs, televisions, laptops, cell phone displays, computer screens, calculators aur gharion mein.

blocks.text: Jaise liquid crystals ki nayi khusoosiyat aur qismein tahqeeq hoti hain, yeh madde sanati aur sciency istemalat mein yaqeenan barhti ahmiyat payenge.

blocks.prompt: Liquid crystals ki kaun si khasoosiyat unhen darja hararat napne wale aalaat mein qabil-e-istemal banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Un ki optical khusoosiyat darja hararat ke saath badalti hain: cholesteric liquid crystal ka rang ya guzarne wali roshni garam ya thanda hone par badalti hai, to patli tah garam jagah (tumour ya kharab jor) ko rang ki tabdeeli ke taur par dikhati hai.

items: Istemal: darja hararat se tumours aur infections ki tashkhees (chhati par cholesteric crystals), garam kharab joron ka pata lagana aur thermometers ka kaam, aur televisions, laptops, phones, calculators aur gharion mein LCD screens.
